messages:
sam: Quick sync: propose we frame the next sprint around an 'Advisor safety gates' story. Scope = advisor recommendations (batch/cache/quant) + eval-triggered alerts + explainable diffs + one-click rollback. Pilot with two tenants (healthcare & commerce).
elaine: sound good. two asks from CS: (1) show exact token delta per-route, (2) include a human-approval gate before any auto-rollback.
raphael: technical note: we'll provide a dry-run mode that annotates requests with estimated tokens_saved and latency_delta. estimator should run fast (<30s per 1k samples).
mira: eval triggers proposal: stewarded sample checks + population drift. example rule: "semantic sim < 0.93 on stewarded set over 200 samples -> alert". alerts must include remediation suggestions.
sam: rollout plan: dry-run -> staged canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%) with a hold if any stewarded alert fires. enable manual abort.
elaine: UX: show before/after diff for 3 stewarded prompts and a confidence score. include an exported CSV and a revert CTA. add an audit log entry for each accept/revert.
raphael: batching presets for pilot: latency-profile {max_batch:12,max_wait_ms:35} and cost-profile {max_batch:56,max_wait_ms:140}. caching default: prefix-kv enabled for hotspots, ttl 45s.
mira: quant policy: require shadow-run sample of 500 requests and thresholds: top-k overlap >= 0.91 AND embedding cosine >= 0.95 to recommend int8. otherwise suggest hybrid (partial quant) or leave as-is.
sam: pilot acceptance metrics (draft): cost reduction >= 9% on cost tenant, p95 latency change <= +25ms on latency tenant, stewarded alert precision >= 96%, rollback path validated end-to-end.
elaine: ops: need replay quota and a small staging pool for shadow runs. also please add a retention policy for pilot telemetry (30d).
raphael: infra blocker noted. will file ENG-INFR ticket for replay quota and tagging OPT-SAFETY-2167.
mira: add alert content templates for CS with suggested customer-safe wording for rollback notifications. reduces triage time.
sam: action items: 1) sam - RFC + acceptance checklist by Tue EOD, 2) raphael - estimator + shadow-run POC by Fri, 3) mira - stewarded sets + alert templates by Thu, 4) elaine - UX mocks + audit log flows by Thu.
ops-bot: infra-bot: reminder - maintenance window 2167890200-2167890600. request infra quota before that window.
sam: locking scope if no objections. please ack with :white_check_mark:.
elaine: ack
raphael: ack
mira: ack
